I saved the draft mail to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting in drafts for a person to send.

- **The draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives $2,101 per seat as Marcus provided it and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Hollis needs CFO or deal desk sign-off to receive it. Anselm is the CFO and approved it himself. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval wasn't needed.
- **Figure not checked against a document:** I couldn't find a Thornbury contract or rate file that Anselm can see, so the $2,101 comes only from his message. I told him this in my reply.
